Windows x64.

## Changes

- Added a favorite toggle in wallpaper details.
- Improved the wallpaper toolbar, source selection, tag chips, sorting, favorites, and empty-result handling.
- Expanded translations for wallpaper and management controls.
- Fixed installed-version detection after updates and embedded the release-tag version in published executables.
- Improved management dialogs and appearance controls.
- Removed download-statistics references from repository documentation.

## Downloads

- **WITH NET10**: single EXE with .NET 10 included.
- **REQUIRES NET10**: smaller single EXE; requires .NET 10 Desktop Runtime.
